entities.description: An elderly woman with deeply wrinkled skin and gray hair sits facing forward, wearing a vibrant green traditional poncho with intricate geometric embroidery in red, blue, yellow, and white, fastened with three large red buttons. Her hands are clasped in her lap, and she wears a dark skirt beneath the poncho, which has fringed edges.
